answer: Make splitting pointless instead of hunting fakes. Pay rewards strictly pro-rata to verified work units, with no per-identity floor, airdrop, vote or welcome bonus, and let governance weight follow the same units. An operator who splits one voyage of effort across a thousand keys earns exactly what a single key would, minus a thousand transaction fees. With no per-head prize, cloning sends no profitable signal, and a violet flag on duplicate accounts becomes moot: the attack has nothing to win.
